videoDetails.title: There is no such thing as greenfield
videoDetails.shortDescription:
Learn why the difference between greenfield and brownfield codebases is largely meaningless in modern software development. Matt explains how real-world constraints, existing code conventions, and documentation design make both types of projects more similar than you'd think.
